newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ refrains from money market operation--traders.
newsitem.headline: BOJ refrains from money market operation--traders.

text.p: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) on Friday refrained from conducting its regular money market operation at 0020 GMT, traders said.
Given the market's net surplus of an estimated 80 billion yen for the day, the BOJ's inaction was seen as a continuation of its accommodative credit stance, traders said.

They said some had expected that the BOJ might return to a neutral operation on Friday by draining 100 billion yen from the market, so this morning's move resulted in a fall in the key overnight call rate to 0.45 percent by 0110 GMT.
The key overnight rate was traded at 0.46 to 0.47 percent earlier in the morning, compared with Thursday's weighted average rate of 0.48 percent. -- Tokyo Treasury Desk +81-33432-8570
